_readme: Per-sample license + source URL. Populated during the curation step before each new mp3 is committed. Day 18 of the Director feature. v1 ship gate: every populated path must have a CC0 or commercially-cleared license + a working source URL. Reject CC-BY-NC and YouTube Audio Library.

_schema.source: URL where the original was downloaded
_schema.license: CC0 | ElevenLabs | CC-BY (with attribution string) | etc.
_schema.attribution: Optional — display string when license requires credit
_schema.addedAt: ISO date the file was committed
